description: This file defines an enumeration for voice wake chimes, including system and custom sounds, and provides a player class for triggering playback while logging events. It also includes catalog utilities for sound options and display names.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Plays the specified voice wake chime and logs the event, including optional reason.

methods.name: sound(for:)
methods.description: Resolves the NSSound object for a given VoiceWakeChime instance.
